about_short_description.short_description: Rawasi Al Bina provides technical services and management consulting for telecoms.

product.name: IBS Solution
product.description: Provides indoor cellular coverage solutions to ensure signal availability inside buildings regardless of structural challenges.

product.name: FTTH, OSP
product.description: Delivers fiber optic connectivity from the network to customers’ premises to support high-speed communication services.

product.name: Power Projects
product.description: Supplies and installs underground and overhead power networks and substations up to 69 kV, including turnkey projects and maintenance.

product.name: Network Integration and Implementation
product.description: Facilitates the integration and deployment of telecom networks to support new technologies and evolving business needs without service disruption.

product.name: Operation & Maintenance
product.description: Provides ongoing operation and maintenance services for telecom and power networks, including electrical and mechanical systems.

product.name: GSM Sites Electromechanical
product.description: Handles installation, dismantling, and removal of telecom towers and related electromechanical equipment for GSM networks.
